responsibleUse: This bounded assessment is advisory. It does not prove exploitability and must be used only for authorized targets.
methodology: Safe-passive header, cookie, CORS, transport, content, and disclosure inspection
Evidence redaction before persistence and report generation

findings.title: Permissive CORS origin policy detected
findings.evidence:
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: false
Evidence fixture contains no customer data.

rationale.explanation: Impact 6/10 and exploitability 5/10 produce the documented 5.6/10 assessment score.

findings.remediation: Replace wildcard origins with a minimal explicit allowlist and do not combine wildcard origins with credentialed requests.

findings.title: Content Security Policy is not configured
findings.evidence:
Content-Security-Policy header absent in the fixture response.
server: DemoGateway/1.0

rationale.explanation: Impact 6/10 and exploitability 5/10 produce the documented 5.6/10 assessment score.

findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy and tune it using report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.title: Cookie lacks the HttpOnly attribute
findings.evidence:
Set-Cookie: session=[REDACTED]; Secure; SameSite=Lax
HttpOnly flag absent in fixture.

rationale.explanation: Impact 6/10 and exploitability 5/10 produce the documented 5.6/10 assessment score.

findings.remediation: Mark session cookies HttpOnly unless browser-side JavaScript access is strictly required.

findings.title: Technology disclosure header detected
findings.evidence:
x-powered-by: Express
Fixture evidence has been normalized and redacted.

rationale.explanation: Impact 3/10 and exploitability 4/10 produce the documented 3.4/10 assessment score.

findings.remediation: Remove or minimize framework and server disclosure headers where they are not operationally required.

findings.title: MIME-sniffing protection is not configured
findings.evidence: X-Content-Type-Options header absent in the fixture response.

rationale.explanation: Impact 4/10 and exploitability 4/10 produce the documented 4/10 assessment score.

findings.remediation: Return X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff with responses that declare correct Content-Type values.

limitations: AI guidance is advisory and never auto-applied
